summary: You take 20 units of STATS courses numbered 300 and above (not 301, 302, 303, 398 or 399) and 10 more units of STATS courses at 200 and above, without research units and with at most one unit of the Consulting Workshop, each letter graded with a B or better. The Statistics department's approval of your courses and both departments' approval of the minor form are checked by hand.
